# Transformer Attention: Scaled Dot-Product

## The Intuition

Attention lets each position in a sequence **selectively look at** other positions. Instead of processing tokens in a fixed window (as RNNs do), every token can directly attend to every other token in a single step.

Think of it as a **weighted lookup**:

| Role | Analogy | Shape |
|------|---------|-------|
| **Query (Q)** | "What am I looking for?" | `(batch, seq, d_k)` |
| **Key (K)** | "What am I labeled as?" | `(batch, seq, d_k)` |
| **Value (V)** | "What I actually contain" | `(batch, seq, d_v)` |

Each query dot-products against every key, producing a **relevance score**. After normalizing those scores with softmax, they become weights over the values. The output is a **weighted sum of values** — a new representation that "knows" about the most relevant parts of the sequence.

## The Formula

$$\text{Attention}(Q, K, V) = \text{softmax}\!\left(\frac{QK^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}}\right) V$$
